title: List all missions with agency and status
description: Returns mission name, agency, status, and launch date ordered by launch date.

title: List all celestial bodies by type
description: Returns celestial body name, type, distance from Sun, and radius ordered by distance.

title: Events for a specific mission (e.g. Voyager 1)
description: Returns all events for a named mission with date, type, description, nearest body, distance, and velocity.

title: All flyby events with mission name and target body
description: Returns all flyby events across missions with date, description, target body, and distance.

title: Missions targeting a specific body (e.g. Mars)
description: Returns missions targeting a named celestial body with agency and launch date.

title: Count missions by agency
description: Returns the number of missions per agency, ordered by count descending.

title: Count events by target body
description: Returns the number of events per celestial body, ordered by count descending.
query:
PREFIX ss: <http://trustgraph.ai/ontology/solar-system#>

SELECT ?bodyName (COUNT(?event) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?event ss:nearest-body ?body .
  ?body ss:name ?bodyName .
}
GROUP BY ?bodyName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

title: Mission timeline — all events across all missions sorted by date
description: Returns a chronological timeline of all mission events with distance from Sun.

title: Furthest events from the Sun
description: Returns mission events ordered by distance from the Sun, furthest first.
